title: REQ · Claude adapter runs the CLI through an Exec interface with a fixed argument list
summary: Claude adapter invokes claude with a fixed prompt and no shell
description: Context: provider_kind claude is accepted by config but has no agent. Desired behavior: Claude.Run calls Exec.Run(ctx, workDir, "claude", args) with args built from a constant prompt telling it to implement the structured tasks, never player text, and returns cost 0 or the wrapped error. Expected result: a real adapter that tests can fake. Why: community prompts are untrusted.
acceptance_criteria: Given a fake Exec, When Claude.Run is called with workDir W, Then Exec receives dir W, name claude and a non-empty args slice
Given Exec returns an error, When Claude.Run is called, Then the error is returned wrapped with provider claude
Given a nil Exec, When NewClaude is called, Then it returns an error

out_of_scope: a real os/exec implementation of Exec
